steps.details: Confirm pre-June 14, 1979 occupancy/coverage and no exemption on parcel records; read both leases. For Unit 1 decide whether April 1, 2026 created a fixed term (no mid-term increase unless expressly allowed) or month-to-month tenancy.

steps.action: Reconcile base rent, ledger and repair history
steps.details: Prove current base rent (base only, excluding temporary passthroughs), every prior increase/passthrough, anniversary dates, open repair requests, inspections and citations. Screen the 35-day unabated-citation bar before any notice.

steps.action: Create the owner account on the Rent Board Portal
steps.details: Create an account at portal.sfrb.org under Property Owners/Managers and link the property by APN/PIN; call 311 (415-701-2311 outside SF) if PIN help is needed.

steps.action: Submit the Individual Unit Housing Inventory report for each unit
steps.details: Use Individual Unit (not the 5+ unit Excel bulk template). Report per unit under penalty of perjury: owner/manager habitability contact, business registration number if any, approx. sq ft in 250-ft increments, bedrooms/baths, occupancy/vacancy dates, base rent in $250 increments and landlord-paid utilities. Good-faith approximations are protected.

steps.action: Download and save each unit's Rent Increase License; verify publicly
steps.details: Download the license PDF for Unit 1 and Unit 2 and re-check status by address/APN search. The license need not be attached to the tenant notice, but must be current on the effective date.

steps.action: Separate the Rent Board Fee from the free licence
steps.details: Check the $59.00 per dwelling unit fee for 2026–27 (due March 1). Note December 14, 2026 deadline for a 2027 fee exemption request if any unit qualifies. Never fold the 50% ($29.50) recovery into base rent; recover only as the fee pages direct after full payment.

steps.action: Apply one neutral written policy and compute without rounding up
steps.details: Use the Form 571 rate in force on the effective date, on base rent only. Add banked percentages additively; never compound or round up. Keep the written policy, ledger and worksheet with the notice file.

State current base, dollar increase, percentage, new base, effective date, and the annual vs banked split with banked basis dates. Include every §37.3(b)/Rule 4.10 item rather than relying on non-voidness provisos.

steps.action: Serve by a statutory method and keep proof
steps.details: Personal delivery or USPS mail under CCP §1013 only. Allow 30 days (35 by CA mail) at 10% or less, 90 days (95 by CA mail) above 10%, counting other increases in the 12-month look-back. Keep proof of service / certificate of mailing with mailing notation.

steps.action: Re-verify on the effective date and renew annually
steps.details: Re-check licence status on the effective date, renew Housing Inventory by March 1 each year, and update owner/manager contact changes within 30 days. Re-check File #261020 before any banked notice.

flags.item: Unit 2 current base rent not certified
flags.missing: Lease + full ledger proving $3,150.00 is still the current base rent and what it includes
flags.effect: Every Unit 2 dollar figure is conditional until proved
flags.action: Verify from lease/ledger before using any Unit 2 scenario

flags.item: Unit 2 prior-increase history (bank) unproved
flags.missing: Every increase notice/ledger entry since June 1, 2019
flags.effect: Any prior increase reduces or eliminates the assumed 11.5% bank and can change notice band/anniversary
flags.action: Rebuild the bank year-by-year from records only

flags.item: Unit 1 fixed-term vs month-to-month status unknown
flags.missing: April 1, 2026 instrument: term, expiry and any escalation clause
flags.effect: A closed fixed term can bar a February 1, 2027 increase entirely
flags.action: Read the instrument; if fixed without escalation, wait for a lawful date and re-price at the then-current rate

flags.item: Rent Increase License status per unit unverified here
flags.missing: Dated Portal licence evidence for Unit 1 and Unit 2 covering the effective date
flags.effect: No licence on the effective date = entire annual/banked increase null and void; tenant owes nothing for suspension months
flags.action: Complete Step 4–5 and save dated PDFs before serving; re-check on effective date

flags.item: Pending File #261020 could retroactively cap banked increases
flags.missing: Final enacted text/status after November 11, 2026 check (then: Pending Committee Action)
flags.effect: Banked notices on/after September 15, 2026 above the proposed 10% banked+capital cap face rollback exposure; excess preserved only for 2030+ if enacted as drafted
flags.action: Re-check Legistar + Rent Board warning immediately before any banked notice; consider U2-C1/U2-C2

flags.item: Coverage/exemption not confirmed on parcel records
flags.missing: Property Information Map / Rent Board confirmation for the 1940 building and each unit
flags.effect: An exempt unit falls outside the local cap analysis
flags.action: Confirm coverage before relying on Form 571 figures

flags.item: Base-rent composition (services vs passthroughs) undocumented
flags.missing: What $3,995.00 / $3,150.00 include (parking/storage/utilities/passthroughs)
flags.effect: Bundled temporary charges change the lawful dollar amount
flags.action: Itemize base vs temporary charges from lease/ledger

flags.item: Unit 1 anniversary / prior-increase history incomplete
flags.missing: 2025 lease, April 2026 paperwork, every later notice and full ledger
flags.effect: Changes anniversary, available bank and service calendar
flags.action: Prove last-increase date before fixing an effective date

flags.item: Whether a §6.14 notice was served on Placeholder Tenant 1D
flags.missing: Any §6.14 notice + proof/date of service (60-day benchmark ~May 31, 2026 if co-occupant route)
flags.effect: Does not change today's 1.6% math while Tenant 1A remains; can decide a future reset claim
flags.action: Locate or reconstruct the service record; get advice before asserting any future reset

flags.item: Placeholder Tenant 1D status: co-tenant vs subtenant/assignee
flags.missing: Agreement + rent-acceptance/conduct evidence classifying Tenant 1D
flags.effect: Costa-Hawkins never reaches a co-tenant; §6.14 can reach either if timely noticed
flags.action: Classify from documents/conduct; do not label by convenience

flags.item: Repair, citation and petition history unscreened
flags.missing: Repair requests, DBI/DPH inspections/citations, Failure-to-Repair or other petitions
flags.effect: 35-day unabated citation bars notice; qualifying repair petition (60 days after notice) can defer the increase
flags.action: Complete repairs and clear citations before serving; calendar the 60-day window

flags.item: Retaliation screen (180-day + general) not yet performed on facts
flags.missing: 180-day timeline of complaints/inspections/proceedings, rent-default status, lawful-cause/good-faith record
flags.effect: Retaliatory increases are unlawful even if arithmetic is correct; no blanket clearance or blanket ban applies
flags.action: Build a dated timeline before selecting units/dates

flags.item: One-unit vs both-units selection must be documented as neutral
flags.missing: Written neutral policy + per-unit eligibility reasons fixed before service
flags.effect: Protected-trait, retaliatory or bad-faith selection creates FEHA/Unruh/FHA/§37.10B exposure; identical treatment is not a safe harbour for an ineligible unit
flags.action: Use lease/base/anniversary/rate/bank records only; keep the policy with both files

flags.item: Business Registration Certificate facts incomplete
flags.missing: Whether owner has other SF business activity, payroll, additional buildings or any short-term rental
flags.effect: <4-unit carve-out applies only 'by reason of that fact alone'; other activity can require registration (separate from rent validity)
flags.action: Confirm with Treasurer guidance; enter BAN in Inventory only if any

flags.item: No official SF dataset: corporate vs individual increase behaviour
flags.missing: Official dataset measuring typical annual/banking behaviour by owner type in SF/94122
flags.effect: Behaviour comparison stays qualitative; do not substitute industry averages or stereotypes
flags.action: None — leave blank; rely on per-unit records

flags.item: No official ZIP-94122 'normal/market' increase figure
flags.missing: Official permissible/typical market increase for covered units in 94122
flags.effect: Value stays blank; Form 571 ceiling is the only verified benchmark
flags.action: Do not import commercial listing averages

flags.item: Legacy editions predate November 9, 2026 File #261020 warning
flags.missing: Updated warning in editions generated November 6–7, 2026 (docs/dashboard/portal/review/integration families)
flags.effect: Readers of preserved editions miss the proposed September 15, 2026 banked-notice cutoff
flags.action: Use this handbook/canonical dashboard for decisions; legacy pages are archives

flags.item: Rent Board Fee payment / exemption status per unit unverified
flags.missing: Portal fee balance, payment proof and any approved exemption for Unit 1 and Unit 2 (incl. December 14, 2026 deadline for the 2027 cycle if any unit qualifies)
flags.effect: Fee arrears accrue 5%/month late penalties (max 15%) separately from the free licence; an unproved exemption cannot be assumed
flags.action: Check fee status on the Portal; pay or file any exemption request by its deadline; never fold the 50% recovery into base rent

flags.item: Official worked-example year-label errors on Rent Board web pages
flags.missing: Corrected narrative examples (Form 571 periods control)
flags.effect: Copying example years misstates which rate applies
flags.action: Always price from Form 571, never from example prose

flags.item: Free tenant representation not guaranteed
flags.missing: Provider-by-provider eligibility, scope, cost and capacity confirmation
flags.effect: Referral listing (incl. Sunset 94122 office) is a directory, not a promise of free representation for notice review
flags.action: Tenants confirm directly; owners must not promise representation

flags.item: 2027–28 annual rate unpublished at verification
flags.missing: Form 571 rate effective March 1, 2027
flags.effect: Any scenario effective after February 28, 2027 cannot be priced yet
flags.action: Leave blank; re-check Form 571 on/after March 1, 2027

flags.item: Commercially sourced legacy pages still served (site/ + research/)
flags.missing: Withdrawal/supersession treatment claimed by a concurrent session (J4) but not yet on main at audit time
flags.effect: Non-official citations remain reachable outside the canonical/handbook editions
flags.action: Do not rely on site/research for law; use official links in this handbook

flags.item: Service-date arithmetic assumes timely, provable service
flags.missing: Actual proof of service / mailing certificate, holiday/weekend handling and 12-month look-back totals
flags.effect: Late or unprovable service moves the earliest lawful effective date
flags.action: Serve well before the last date; retain proof with the notice copy

flags.item: Pre-redaction Git history remains reachable
flags.missing: History rewrite (e.g., filter-repo) by a repository administrator — outside any single session's safe scope
flags.effect: Current files pass privacy scans, but old blobs persist in history; never link to pre-redaction revisions
flags.action: Disclosed without reproducing any identifier; admin decision required

review.test: Coverage: is each unit under Chapter 37 rent control?
review.evidence: 1940 build date + parcel/exemption check per unit

review.test: Licence: current Rent Increase License on the effective date?
review.evidence: Dated Portal licence PDFs for Unit 1 and Unit 2

review.test: Rate: Form 571 percentage in force on the effective date?
review.evidence: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027; blank after that

review.test: Base: applied to base rent only, no rounding up?
review.evidence: Lease/ledger split of base vs temporary passthroughs; cent-exact worksheet

review.test: Lease + 12 months: does the lease allow an increase now?
review.evidence: Both leases/amendments; last-increase dates; Unit 1 April 2026 term analysis

review.test: Banking: each banked point actually skipped and eligible?
review.evidence: Year-by-year ledger + Form 571 periods; 24-month guidance and Rule 4.12 12-month points both checked

review.test: Pending law: File #261020 re-checked before banked notice?
review.evidence: Legistar status/final text + Rent Board warning on the day of service

review.test: Notice content: annual vs banked split with basis dates?
review.evidence: Final notice copy showing dollars, %, new base, effective date and banked dates
Proof of service / mailing certificate; 30/35 or 90/95-day count incl. look-back

review.test: Repairs: any open request that could defer the increase?
review.evidence: Repair log; completion before effective date; 60-day petition calendar
Confirm no hardship deferral is claimed for annual/banked CPI (passthrough/O&M only)

review.test: Retaliation: 180-day + general anti-retaliation screen clean on facts?
review.evidence: Dated protected-activity timeline, rent status, lawful-cause record

review.test: Discrimination/harassment: neutral selection, no push-out motive?
review.evidence: Written neutral policy fixed before service; no protected-trait input; no algorithmic pricing

review.test: Occupants: original occupant remains; no roommate surcharge; §6.14 record kept?
review.evidence: 2025 lease + April 2026 documents, occupancy proof, any §6.14 notice, Tenant 1D classification

review.test: Tenant can verify/challenge without a lawyer?
review.evidence: Notice file points to Portal lookup, Rent Board petitions (518/516C/516B) and referral listing; no promise of free counsel
